name: Governance, Risk and Compliance
tools: ServiceNow IRM or Archer or OneTrust (demo)

beginner.summary: For new GRC analysts, IT and security staff and auditors. Covers governance structures, policies and standards, risk concepts, risk assessment, risk registers and treatment, controls and frameworks, laws and regulations, ISO/IEC 27001, NIST CSF 2.0, third-party risk, audits, evidence, business continuity, incident obligations, privacy compliance, awareness, reporting and GRC tools.
prerequisites: Works in IT, security, audit, finance or operations
Comfortable with spreadsheets and writing documents
outcomes: Explain governance, risk and compliance and how they fit together
Run a simple risk assessment and keep a risk register
Map controls to ISO/IEC 27001 and NIST CSF and collect audit evidence
Report risk and compliance status clearly

days.topic: GRC Overview, Roles and Course Setup
subtopics: What governance, risk and compliance mean
GRC roles: analyst, risk manager, compliance officer and auditor
Frameworks and standards at a glance
Laws and regulators in India, the EU and the US
The course case company: a fintech with 800 staff
Course templates: risk register, control matrix and policy pack
Setting up a demo GRC tool or spreadsheet workbook
days.lab_task: Set up the course workbook or demo GRC tool, map the case company's main risks and obligations at a high level and place each GRC role in the three lines model.
days.deliverable: Set-up workbook, obligations list and three lines diagram
checks: At least eight laws and standards with owners
Each role in the right line
Governance, risk and compliance described with examples

subtopics: Governance documents: charters and terms of reference
days.lab_task: Draw the governance structure for the case company, write terms of reference for an IT risk committee and build a RACI for security decisions.
days.deliverable: Structure diagram, terms of reference and RACI

days.lab_task: Write an acceptable use policy and a password standard for the case company, define an exception process and plan the review cycle.
days.deliverable: Policy, standard and exception process
checks: Plain language with scope and owner
Exception approved with an expiry date

days.lab_task: Define likelihood and impact scales for the case company, rate ten example risks inherently and after controls and explain the difference.
days.deliverable: Risk scales and rated examples
checks: Each risk has a business owner

days.lab_task: Run a role-play risk workshop for the case company's payments process, identify and rate eight risks and validate them with the process owner.
days.deliverable: Workshop notes and risk assessment
checks: Owner agrees or changes are recorded

subtopics: Treatment options: avoid, reduce, transfer and accept
days.lab_task: Enter the assessed risks into a register, choose a treatment for each, write two treatment plans and document one risk acceptance with sign-off.
days.deliverable: Risk register, treatment plans and acceptance record
checks: Every risk has an owner, rating and treatment
Signed by an authorised person with an expiry

subtopics: Common frameworks: ISO 27001, NIST, COBIT and CIS Controls
days.lab_task: Build a control matrix for the payments process, classify each control and map controls to the risks they reduce.
days.deliverable: Control matrix with risk mapping
checks: Type and nature correct for each
Each high risk has at least one control

subtopics: India: DPDP Act, IT Act, CERT-In directions and RBI guidance
US: SOX, HIPAA and state privacy laws
days.lab_task: Build an obligation register for the case company, map each obligation to owners and controls and find two obligations with no control.
days.deliverable: Obligation register and gap list
checks: Laws and rules relevant to the company listed

days.topic: Information Security Management Systems with ISO/IEC 27001
subtopics: Annex A controls in the 2022 version
days.lab_task: Define an ISMS scope for the case company, draft a Statement of Applicability for ten Annex A controls with reasons and plan the certification steps.
days.deliverable: Scope statement, draft SoA and certification plan
checks: Each control included or excluded with a reason

subtopics: Functions: Govern, Identify, Protect, Detect, Respond and Recover
days.lab_task: Build current and target CSF profiles for the case company, find the largest gaps and present a one-page summary to management.
days.deliverable: Profiles, gap list and summary

days.lab_task: Build a vendor register, tier five vendors, review one vendor's questionnaire answers and write findings and contract requirements.
days.deliverable: Vendor register, tiering and review findings
checks: Tiers justified by data access and criticality

days.topic: How Audits Work: Internal and External Audit
days.lab_task: Plan an access review audit, test a sample of 25 user accounts, rate the findings and write management responses with dates.
days.deliverable: Audit plan, test results and findings report

days.lab_task: Collect evidence for five controls, index it in a repository, review a colleague's evidence for problems and fix them.
days.deliverable: Evidence index and review notes
checks: Each item linked to a control and period
Problems found such as wrong dates

days.topic: Business Continuity and Disaster Recovery Planning
days.lab_task: Run a business impact analysis for three processes, set RTO and RPO, write a continuity plan for one and run a tabletop exercise.
days.deliverable: BIA, continuity plan and exercise notes
checks: Impacts and recovery times for each process

subtopics: Breach notification rules: CERT-In six hours, GDPR 72 hours and others
days.lab_task: Work through a data breach scenario, decide which regulators and customers to notify and when, draft notifications and record the incident.
days.deliverable: Notification decision log and drafts

days.lab_task: Build records of processing for three activities, review a privacy notice against the DPDP Act and handle a data access request.
days.deliverable: Records, notice review and request record
checks: Purpose, data, retention and sharing listed

days.lab_task: Plan a year of awareness activities, run a mock phishing campaign, analyse results and design follow-up training.
days.deliverable: Awareness plan, campaign results and training plan
checks: Topics and audiences for each quarter
Training aimed at the weakest groups

days.topic: Risk and Compliance Metrics and Reporting
days.lab_task: Define five key risk indicators, build a dashboard of risk and compliance status and write a one-page management report.
days.deliverable: KRI definitions, dashboard and report
checks: Each has a threshold and owner
Key messages and decisions needed clear

subtopics: GRC platforms: ServiceNow IRM, Archer, OneTrust and MetricStream
tools: ServiceNow IRM or Archer or OneTrust demo
days.lab_task: Load the risk register and control matrix into a demo GRC tool, run a control attestation workflow and compare the tool with the spreadsheet.
days.deliverable: Loaded tool, attestation results and comparison
checks: Risks and controls in the tool

days.topic: Beginner Capstone: GRC Starter Programme for the Case Company
days.lab_task: Build a starter GRC programme for the case company: governance structure, two policies, a risk assessment and register, a control matrix mapped to ISO 27001 and obligations, evidence for five controls and a management report.
days.deliverable: Programme pack and presentation
checks: Policies, register, matrix and evidence consistent
Risk linked to controls, obligations and evidence
objectives: Combine the beginner topics in one programme

intermediate.summary: For GRC analysts, risk managers and auditors with some experience. Covers risk quantification with FAIR, control design and testing, SOC 2, implementing ISO/IEC 27001, NIST SP 800-53 and unified control frameworks, SOX IT general controls, PCI DSS, privacy programmes, third-party risk programmes, cloud compliance, continuous control monitoring, policy lifecycle, risk appetite, business continuity programmes, regulatory change, audit management, GRC platform implementation, KRIs and AI governance.
prerequisites: Has run risk assessments and kept risk registers
outcomes: Quantify and prioritise risk and set appetite
Design, test and monitor controls for SOC 2, ISO 27001, SOX and PCI DSS
Run privacy, vendor, continuity and regulatory change programmes
Implement GRC platforms and govern AI use

subtopics: Loss event frequency and loss magnitude
days.lab_task: Quantify a ransomware risk for the case company with FAIR, run a Monte Carlo simulation and compare the value of two controls.
days.deliverable: FAIR analysis, simulation and recommendation
checks: Risk reduction per rupee spent compared

subtopics: Test of design and test of operating effectiveness
Test procedures: inquiry, observation, inspection and re-performance
days.lab_task: Design three access controls, test their design and operating effectiveness with samples, rate deficiencies and plan remediation.
days.deliverable: Control designs, test workpapers and deficiency ratings

subtopics: SOC 2 and the trust services criteria
days.lab_task: Run a SOC 2 readiness assessment for the case company's platform, map controls to criteria, fix two gaps and review a vendor's SOC 2 report for exceptions.
days.deliverable: Readiness report, mapping and vendor review

days.lab_task: Produce the core ISMS documents for the case company, complete the risk treatment plan and SoA, run an internal audit of three clauses and hold a management review.
days.deliverable: ISMS documents, internal audit report and review minutes

days.topic: NIST SP 800-53 and Unified Control Frameworks
subtopics: Testing once and reporting many times
days.lab_task: Build a unified control set covering ISO 27001, SOC 2 and NIST CSF, map existing controls and show one test satisfying three frameworks.
days.deliverable: Unified control framework and mapping
checks: Each control linked to all frameworks it meets
One test result used for three frameworks

subtopics: ITGC domains: access, change, operations and development
days.lab_task: Scope ITGCs for an ERP system, test user access and change management controls, review a SOC 1 report and assess a deficiency.
days.deliverable: Scope, test workpapers and deficiency assessment

subtopics: Self-assessment questionnaires and reports on compliance
days.lab_task: Scope the case company's card payment environment, find ways to reduce scope, choose the right assessment type and prepare evidence for three requirements.
days.deliverable: Scope diagram, scope reduction plan and evidence
checks: Systems in and out of scope correct
Tokenisation or segmentation plan with effect

days.lab_task: Run a DPIA for a new customer analytics project, design the data subject request process and plan cross-border transfer safeguards.
days.deliverable: DPIA, request process and transfer plan
checks: Steps and deadlines meet the law

days.lab_task: Design a vendor risk programme with intake, tiering and assessment by tier, monitor a vendor with security ratings and manage an issue through to closure.
days.deliverable: Programme design, monitoring results and issue record

tools: AWS Artifact or Azure compliance tools
days.lab_task: Map cloud responsibilities for the case company's platform, collect provider attestations, run a CSPM compliance scan and close three findings.
days.deliverable: Responsibility map, attestations and scan results

subtopics: Data sources: identity, cloud and tickets
days.lab_task: Automate monitoring for three controls (leaver access removal, MFA coverage and patch timeliness), alert on failures and build a dashboard.
days.deliverable: Monitors, alerts and dashboard

subtopics: Mapping policies to controls and obligations
days.lab_task: Move policies into a policy tool, map them to controls, run an attestation campaign and report exceptions and completion.
days.deliverable: Policy library, mapping and attestation report

days.lab_task: Draft risk appetite statements for cyber, privacy and third-party risk, set tolerances linked to KRIs and define the escalation for breaches.
days.deliverable: Appetite statements, tolerances and escalation process
checks: Each tolerance tied to a KRI
Breach routed to the right committee

subtopics: Recovery plans for IT and business
days.lab_task: Set up a continuity programme with BIAs for ten processes, recovery strategies, a test schedule and supplier continuity checks, and run a recovery test.
days.deliverable: Programme documents, BIAs and test report

days.lab_task: Assess the impact of a new regulation such as DPDP rules or DORA on the case company, assign actions and track them to completion.
days.deliverable: Impact assessment and action tracker
checks: Owners and dates for each action

days.lab_task: Build a risk-based audit plan, manage an audit request list, find root causes for three findings and track remediation with validation.
days.deliverable: Audit plan, request tracker and issue records

subtopics: Data model: risks, controls, issues and assets
Integrations with CMDB, identity and ticketing
tools: ServiceNow IRM or Archer or OneTrust
days.lab_task: Configure a GRC platform for risks, controls and issues, migrate data from spreadsheets, integrate with the CMDB and build reports for owners.
days.deliverable: Configuration, migrated data and reports

days.topic: Key Risk Indicators and GRC Dashboards
tools: Power BI or GRC platform dashboards
days.lab_task: Build automated KRIs for cyber and third-party risk, dashboards for managers and executives and a monthly review pack.
days.deliverable: KRIs, dashboards and review pack
checks: Managers and executives see different detail

days.topic: AI Governance: EU AI Act, ISO/IEC 42001 and NIST AI RMF
subtopics: The EU AI Act risk categories
days.lab_task: Build an AI inventory for the case company, classify systems under the EU AI Act, run an AI impact assessment and write an AI use policy.
days.deliverable: Inventory, classifications, impact assessment and policy
checks: Risk category with reasons for each

days.lab_task: Build an integrated compliance programme for the case company covering ISO 27001, SOC 2 and the DPDP Act: unified controls, testing and continuous monitoring, quantified top risks, vendor and privacy processes and executive dashboards, then present it.
days.deliverable: Programme pack, platform configuration, dashboards and presentation
checks: Requirement linked to control, test and evidence
Risks in money terms with decisions requested
objectives: Combine the intermediate topics in one programme

advanced.summary: For GRC leaders, chief risk and compliance officers and senior auditors. Covers enterprise risk management, board reporting, GRC operating models, GRC engineering and compliance automation, operational resilience, cyber risk quantification at scale, supervisory engagement, M&A due diligence, AI governance programmes, privacy across borders, supply chain risk, integrated assurance, crisis management, risk analytics, GRC platform architecture, conduct and culture, major regulatory breaches and GRC strategy.
prerequisites: Leads or runs risk, compliance or audit work
Has implemented frameworks such as ISO 27001, SOC 2 or SOX
outcomes: Lead enterprise risk and compliance programmes and report to boards
Automate compliance and quantify risk at scale
Manage resilience, supply chain, AI and privacy risk across regions
Handle regulators, crises and major breaches

days.topic: Enterprise Risk Management with COSO and ISO 31000
days.lab_task: Build an enterprise risk taxonomy for the case company, link top risks to strategic objectives, aggregate department risks and assess ERM maturity.
days.deliverable: Taxonomy, risk profile and maturity assessment
checks: Each top risk tied to an objective

subtopics: Risk in business and money terms
days.lab_task: Write a board risk report for the case company, present it to a role-play board and answer challenging questions.
days.deliverable: Board report and presentation recording
checks: Top risks, trends and decisions clear

days.topic: GRC Operating Models and the Three Lines
days.lab_task: Design the GRC operating model for a group with five businesses, define roles across the three lines and plan the move from the current model.
days.deliverable: Operating model, RACI and transition plan

subtopics: Integrations with cloud, identity and code repositories
days.lab_task: Write policies as code for three cloud controls, build a pipeline that collects evidence and tests controls daily and agree the evidence format with an auditor.
days.deliverable: Policies, pipeline and evidence samples
checks: Break a policy in the cloud

days.topic: Operational Resilience: DORA, RBI and Global Rules
subtopics: RBI and other regulator expectations in India
days.lab_task: Identify important business services for the case company, set impact tolerances, map dependencies, run a severe scenario test and report gaps against DORA.
days.deliverable: Service list, tolerances, maps, test report and gap report

days.lab_task: Quantify the top ten cyber risks, aggregate them into a portfolio view, decide on insurance limits and prioritise the security budget.
days.deliverable: Portfolio analysis, insurance recommendation and budget priorities

days.lab_task: Prepare for a role-play regulator inspection on cyber risk, answer document requests, handle an interview and write a remediation plan for findings.
days.deliverable: Preparation pack, interview notes and remediation plan

days.topic: Risk in Mergers, Acquisitions and Divestments
days.lab_task: Run GRC due diligence on a target company, report red flags with deal impact and plan day-one controls after the acquisition.
days.deliverable: Due diligence report and day-one plan

subtopics: Generative AI controls: data, prompts and outputs
Reporting AI risk to the board
days.lab_task: Implement core ISO 42001 elements for the case company, assess five AI systems, set controls for staff use of generative AI and report AI risk to the board.
days.deliverable: AI management system documents, assessments and board report
checks: Data, prompt and output controls defined

days.topic: Global Privacy Programmes and Cross-Border Data
subtopics: Building one programme for many laws
days.lab_task: Design a privacy programme covering the DPDP Act, GDPR and US state laws, run a transfer impact assessment and handle a cross-border privacy incident.
days.deliverable: Programme design, assessment and incident record

days.lab_task: Map critical suppliers and their dependencies, find concentration risks including a cloud provider, write an exit plan and review SBOM practices for key software.
days.deliverable: Supplier map, concentration analysis and exit plan

days.lab_task: Build an assurance map for the case company, find duplicated and missing assurance and plan one combined audit for ISO 27001 and SOC 2.
days.deliverable: Assurance map and combined audit plan
checks: One test plan serving both frameworks

subtopics: Communication with staff, customers, media and regulators
days.lab_task: Run a crisis exercise for a ransomware attack with executives, make decisions on payment, disclosure and recovery and write the after-action report.
days.deliverable: Exercise log, decisions and after-action report

subtopics: Linking GRC data with operational data
Text analysis of incidents and findings
days.lab_task: Analyse two years of incidents, findings and control results to find patterns, predict which controls are likely to fail and present insights.
days.deliverable: Analysis, prediction and insights presentation
checks: Controls at risk listed with reasons

subtopics: Integrations: CMDB, identity, cloud, HR and ticketing
Single source of truth for risks and controls
days.lab_task: Design the GRC platform architecture for a group with three existing tools, plan consolidation and integrations and estimate effort and cost.
days.deliverable: Architecture, consolidation plan and estimate
checks: Risks, controls, assets and issues linked

days.lab_task: Design culture indicators for the case company, analyse speak-up and survey data, run a role-play investigation and report culture risk to the board.
days.deliverable: Indicators, analysis, investigation notes and report

days.topic: Responding to a Major Regulatory Breach
subtopics: Working with regulators after a breach
days.lab_task: Lead the response to a simulated major data protection breach: contain, notify, find the root cause, design a remediation programme and brief the regulator.
days.deliverable: Response log, root cause analysis, remediation programme and briefing

subtopics: ESG risks for technology and services companies
Reporting standards: BRSR in India, CSRD and ISSB
Climate risk in the risk register
days.lab_task: Map the case company's ESG reporting duties, design controls over the emissions and workforce data used in reports and add climate risk to the enterprise risk register.
days.deliverable: Duty map, control design and updated risk register

days.lab_task: Write a three-year GRC strategy for the case company with a roadmap, investment case and success measures, and present it to a role-play executive committee.
days.deliverable: Strategy, roadmap, investment case and presentation

days.lab_task: For a case financial group, assess GRC maturity, design the operating model and unified controls, automate key controls, quantify top risks, build resilience and AI governance and present a funded transformation plan to the board.
days.deliverable: Assessment, design, automation demo, risk analysis and board presentation
checks: Control failure detected and tracked automatically
Top risks in money terms with treatment options
Defend the plan to the board
objectives: Combine the advanced topics in one transformation
